description: Source code for the class Table1D, which extends TableWithData, representing a 1D data table with GUI interaction and data handling methods within the RomRaider project.

classes.name: Table1D
classes.description: Represents a one-dimensional data table with GUI interaction, data management, and navigation capabilities within the RomRaider project.

methods.name: setAxisParent
methods.description: Sets the parent axis table for this Table1D instance.

methods.name: getAxisParent
methods.description: Returns the parent axis table.

methods.name: addStaticDataCell
methods.description: Adds a static data cell to the table at the first available null position.

methods.name: populateTable
methods.description: Populates the table with data from a byte array, setting layout and labels accordingly.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the table, appending '(1D)'.

methods.name: cursorUp
methods.description: Handles cursor movement upwards within the table based on its type.

methods.name: cursorDown
methods.description: Handles cursor movement downwards within the table based on its type.

methods.name: cursorLeft
methods.description: Handles cursor movement to the left within the table.

methods.name: cursorRight
methods.description: Handles cursor movement to the right within the table.

methods.name: clearSelection
methods.description: Clears the current selection, delegating to the axis parent.

methods.name: startHighlight
methods.description: Starts highlighting a cell at given x, y coordinates, clearing previous selections.

methods.name: getCellAsString
methods.description: Returns the text of the data cell at the specified index.

methods.name: highlightLiveData
methods.description: Highlights data based on live value input, supporting live data trace visualization.

methods.name: isLiveDataSupported
methods.description: Indicates whether live data highlighting is supported (returns false).

methods.name: isButtonSelected
methods.description: Returns true, indicating the button is selected.

methods.name: isAxis
methods.description: Checks if the table is an axis type or static data table.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another Table1D object based on data and type.

methods.name: clearLiveDataTrace
methods.description: Clears live data trace indicators, delegating to axis parent.

methods.name: updateTableLabel
methods.description: Updates the table label via the axis parent.

methods.name: getTableAsString
methods.description: Returns the table data as a string buffer, formatted as static or dynamic data.
